title: MilestoneType - Metadata API
description: Represents the name and description of a milestone, which you can use in an entitlement process to track important steps in cases.

RecurrenceType.description: The type of recurrence for the milestone. Available in API version 29.0 and later. Valid values are: none—Specifies no recurrence for the milestone. The milestone occurs only one time until the entitlement process exits. recursIndependently—Specifies independent recurrence for the milestone. recursChained—Specifies sequential recurrence for the milestone.
